svg.title: Jobs with an LLM comment in 42 days, reviewed share and jobs per job group
svg.desc: In 42 days the four job groups shown had 6,459 jobs with an LLM comment; 142 (2.2%) were later reviewed by a person, and 3,290 (51%) were in the Development group, which is almost never reviewed (4 of 3,290).
